dataset_name: TrustMRR 正常公开目录全分页项目数据；不预筛
collection_scope: TrustMRR public /startups pages, cached public startup .md profiles, their public recommendation cards and cached homepage standard Schema.org JSON-LD only. No other discovery sites; no login/internal APIs. All revenues, zero-revenue, non-web and unknown-cost records retained.
not_a_whole_site_completeness_claim: 遍历公开目录不等于覆盖隐藏、私有、未入目录、采集后新增或删除项目。目录/档案为不同时点快照。
deduplication_key: canonical TrustMRR startup profile URL/slug; same brand with multiple different profiles is NOT merged.

currency_evidence.evidence: Published monetary PropertyValue records explicitly use unitText USD.

field_provenance: Each metric/category/source carries source_url and read_at. core_function_source_url/core_function_read_at locate the description; profile_fields_provenance locates other profile details; directory_snapshot preserves original cards. Cached read_at uses file mtime and is explicitly labeled.
revenue_caveats: MRR ≠ past-30-day revenue ≠ all-time revenue ≠ GMV. Neither revenue nor MRR establishes profit. GMV, when displayed instead of Total, is retained separately and revenue_total remains null.
All directory monetary values are public display values; they may be rounded. K/M abbreviations are decoded, not made exact.
Profile metric snapshots preserve the published figure, not full underlying accounting precision.
TrustMRR homepage public Schema.org monetary records explicitly use USD. Dollar displays are retained in that site currency convention; no FX conversion is performed.
Verification is TrustMRR’s provider-API verification claim, not our independent audit.
Founder-supplied product descriptions, categories, pricing and tech stack are not payment-provider-verified.
costs_and_analysis: All unverified replication costs, inferred web-product status and analysis are null/unknown; no made-up estimates or rankings.
profile_enrichment_scope: Reused all 393 existing public profile files; additional profile enrichment is bounded by this collection stage, not a cap/filter on the full project export.
version_scope: Relevant project facts, not request times, pagination order or provider-sync-only changes. Byte checksums are separate.
index_bytes_note: Initial load is the compact index only; full details are fetched in 100-project chunks.
not_official: 独立商机研究库，非TrustMRR官方；不构成投资或收益承诺。
